make targets

Every target in the diagram skill's Makefile, grouped. 63 documented. Generated from the Makefile - edit the target's ## line, not this page.

Tests

The four tiers, cheapest first. Where a test LIVES decides when it runs, so these differ by scope rather than by filter.

targetargumentswhat it is
make cov-fileFILE MODwhich lines of MOD does ONE test file reach?
make durationsFULL MARKwhere the suite's time goes - run when a target feels slow
make hooks-test–run every scripts/test-*-hooks.sh, and prove each guard still has a companion
make idle-tests–what an idle session runs unattended (feature 136): the whole gate, never FULL, recorded as `idle-done`
make page-check–the interactive tests + the browser test, then the `page` stamp - what an asset edit owes at push
make quickALLtier 2: lint, types and every test that rolls no map; change-selected, stops at the first failure
make soak–the tier ABOVE the gate: the same code over many seeds and larger maps (tests/soak/)
make test–the pytest phase itself (internal - `done` and `test-full` call it, not you)
make test-fileFILErun ONE test file, whole
make test-full–the gate's whole test phase + all three coverage floors (everything except tests/soak/, which only `make soak` runs)
make tooling–run every `tooling` test (make/ci/pipeline, exhaustive) and record them green so `make quick` skips them until the tooling changes
make verify–THE PAIRED RUN: start the gate and dispatch the settlement-review together (feature 151)

Maps

Generating and checking the pool. `reference` is the cheap tripwire everything expensive runs behind.

targetargumentswhat it is
make cache-audit–does using the generation cache change any map?
make citybudgetARGSthe city/capital space-budget planner
make cohortNroll N seeds and report every failure
make compoundARGSdraw a Mode A compound plan
make hamletARGS PROFILEgenerate one hamlet from the CLI
make mapGEN PROFILEregenerate ONE gen and gate it
make mapsSCOPEregenerate and check the pool, picking its own scope from how the last run went
make placement-stages–re-plate the stage-by-stage walk-through page
make pool-index–rebuild the pool index
make pool-index-if-stale–rebuild the pool index only when a manifest, render or notes file is newer
make render-sync–regenerate MAIN's renders (called by sync-with-main.sh; not for hand use)

Diagnostics

Read-only questions about a finished map or a generator's decisions. None of these decides what ships.

targetargumentswhat it is
make crop–crop a rendered map in manifest coordinates
make family-censusA Bwhich feature families one manifest records that another does not
make hamlet-floor–the modules under the 100% hamlet-path floor (feature 145; derived from the scripted rolls' records; GUARD_EDIT_OK: a new operation)
make jogs–find bunds that step sideways
make notes-censusMrefresh the derived counts inside each map's notes census block
make overlap-auditFAMILIES Mdoes A overlap B on a finished map (records AND drawn ink)
make pack-audit–empty space and geometry in a Mode A compound SVG
make polder-probeARCHETYPE SEED SEEDSthe polder block ALONE with its geometry metrics, no map
make scatter-audit–is drawn ground cover standing where keep-outs should have stopped it?
make sun-auditMthe sun rules and the belt's page presence, off the manifest
make timings–where the generation loop's time goes
make why-placedAT GEN REFUSEDwho placed this, and what refused to

Performance

The bookends and the three bands. A run that got slower owes records before the push.

targetargumentswhat it is
make perfLABELtake a performance snapshot of the reference hamlet across its seeds
make perf-auditAS COMMENSURATE NECESSARY NO_WAY_AROUND VERDICTband 2 - the subagent adjudicates
make perf-confirmAS VERDICTband 1, second half - the perf-audit SUBAGENT runs this
make perf-explainENV WHYband 1, first half: the session's written cause
make perf-gate–require the feature's -start bookend, take -end, and FAIL on a regression
make perf-profileSEED STAGEtier 2 evidence: cProfile ONE stage of ONE seed
make perf-reportAGAINST ENVthe trend, and which BAND the newest bookend pair reaches
make perf-review–does every environment's newest bookend pair carry the records its band owes? (the push runs this)
make perf-signoffWHYband 3 - the GM, at a terminal

Remote (AWS CodeBuild)

Everything except `ci-status` costs money. Remote is currently OFF; `make switches` says so.

targetargumentswhat it is
make ci-checkFULL NO_GO TARGETrun the SOAK suite on CodeBuild (PAID)
make ci-image–rebuild the CodeBuild image from Dockerfile.ci and push it to ECR (PAID, ~$$1; prompts)
make ci-measureCOMPUTE FULLMEASURE what the remote gate costs (PAID, prompts)
make ci-mergeFULLthe push's gated route (PAID) - runs the SOAK suite; no longer a merge queue. Called by sync-with-main.sh
make ci-offREASONREMOTE OFF - nothing dispatches to CodeBuild; the gated push lands on a green local make done
make ci-onREASONREMOTE ON - the default; the gated route may dispatch again
make ci-statusROUTEfree: delta, route, verification state, verified lookup, remote spend

Static checks

What the gate runs before it spends anything on a map roll.

targetargumentswhat it is
make format–ruff format over the tree
make guard–refuse to run in main's tree - main is the integration point, never a workspace
make static–the static checks: ruff, duplicate-defs, file-scale, stale-dirs (was `lint`)
make typecheck–pyrefly over the engine, one-shot, no daemon (feature 142)

Project state

Switches, audits and the records that make the tooling's own behavior reviewable.

targetargumentswhat it is
make audit–how the gate has actually been used - every run, every bypass, and remote spend
make bypass-audit–every escape token taken, with the reason its user gave (the FULL prompt reads this)
make commit-permitted–commit the most recent bypass-log entry, which is how a paid FULL run is authorized
make docs–regenerate docs/make-targets.html from this Makefile's own `##` lines
make engine-keyREFthe content hash the gate and the push key on
make help–list every target with its one-line purpose
make switches–the iteration switch: remote on|off, with reason, who and when (feature 132)
make tickBOXES F NOTE Ttick a task: F=188 T=T03 NOTE="what was verified" [BOXES=1 ticks the research boxes]
